_comment: EXAMPLE brand config — output of first-run onboarding. Real configs are gitignored.

colors.policy: exact hexes only; generated art must be prompted with these hexes; composited elements use them literally

typography.accent_policy: accent roles only; primary family always dominates

assets.dp_policy: profile circles ALWAYS use the real DP image, never initials/placeholders

layout_hard_rules.profile_heading_placement: last slide of carousel or minimal post ONLY

restrictions: never render competitor/reference brand names, logos, handles
no company name/logo on personal-profile creatives
mascot: Spider-Man blocked by image models — use approved fallbacks

background_system.C_expressive: DNA-gated: #2D5BFF field, texture, collage, duotone photo
background_system.rule: one variant family per carousel; DNA gates variant choice
